decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent product in a growing and innovative firm, it would usually be retained unless two years of market experience had clearly shown results below aspiration levels.
This condenser still fits the established portfolio, but after another year management would scrutinize it more closely against internal aspirations and against similar offers in the line.

Because it overlaps with other condenser offerings, its withdrawal risk is somewhat higher if comparative performance disappoints, though the firm still has enough slack to keep it absent clear underperformance.
The customized air-cooler line matches the firm's solution-oriented business model and engineering strengths, so management would be reluctant to drop it without strong negative performance evidence.
These repair inserts complement the profitable service and aftermarket business, making continued retention likely unless demand proves persistently too weak relative to aspirations.
